description: SafeSend HOLDOUT set. Synthetic, hand-labeled, written from threat descriptions before evaluation. Frozen: do not edit (see docs/EVAL.md). Never used for tuning.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Dust from a 4/4 lookalike of a contact, minutes after a real send
cases.rationale: Classic tiny-transfer poisoning: right after Daniela pays Lucía, a lookalike sends 0.001 USDC so it sits at the top of her history. She copies it next time.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Zero-value transfer that shows Daniela "sending" to a 5/5 lookalike
cases.rationale: The attacker calls transferFrom(Daniela, lookalike, 0). History shows an outgoing entry from Daniela to the lookalike, which looks like a past send. The attacker signed it.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Counterfeit token named exactly "USDC" from a 4/4 lookalike
cases.rationale: A fake token contract with symbol "USDC" transfers 50 "USDC" from the lookalike, matching the real amount so the row looks legitimate.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Counterfeit token with a slightly different symbol ("USDC.e")
cases.rationale: Counterfeit tokens do not need the exact symbol; "USDC.e" reads as a USDC variant to most users.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Counterfeit token whose symbol uses a Cyrillic "С" (USDС)
cases.rationale: Homoglyph symbol: visually identical to USDC. Symbols are attacker-controlled and cannot be trusted.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Dust lookalike of the landlord (a past recipient, not a contact)
cases.rationale: Attackers target whoever the victim pays, not just saved contacts. The landlord is paid monthly but was never added as a contact.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: 4/4 lookalike pasted from outside the wallet (not in history)
cases.rationale: The lookalike arrives through a chat message or clipboard rather than history. Nothing was planted on-chain, so there is no planting evidence.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Dust lookalike matching only 3 leading and 3 trailing characters
cases.rationale: Cheaper lookalike, still convincing when a wallet shows 0x + 4 and 4 characters to a hurried user. Small amount.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Dust lookalike matching 2 leading and 4 trailing characters
cases.rationale: Users often check only the end of an address. Weak prefix match, full suffix match, small amount.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: High-effort 6/6 vanity lookalike via zero-value transfer, large send
cases.rationale: Well-funded attackers generate longer matches for high-value victims (the $12M and $50M cases).

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Planting transfer of 0.50 USDC (larger than typical dust)
cases.rationale: Some attackers send more than a few cents so the row looks like a normal payment.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Dust lookalike of a new recipient lands right after a test send
cases.rationale: Daniela test-sends 1 USDC to a new friend. Two blocks later a lookalike of the friend dusts her. She sends the rest by copying from history.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Lookalike mirrors the 1 USDC test amount after a test send
cases.rationale: Instead of dust, the attacker sends back exactly 1 USDC so the row looks like the friend returning the test.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: 4/4 lookalike while history could not be loaded
cases.rationale: Explorer and RPC are down. The user still pastes a lookalike of a contact.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Repeat victim: already sent to the lookalike once
cases.rationale: Daniela fell for a dust lookalike last month and sent 50 to it. The attacker address is now in her outgoing history as a signed send.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Lookalike of her son, who only ever sends TO her
cases.rationale: Daniela wants to send money back to Mateo for the first time and copies his address from history, where a dusted lookalike of Mateo sits on top.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Zero-value planting whose signer could not be determined
cases.rationale: Partial data source (log-only RPC): the zero-value entry is visible but the tx signer is unknown.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: One base unit (0.000001 USDC) from a 3/4 lookalike
cases.rationale: Smallest possible real-token transfer; matches the CMU 3-leading/4-trailing criterion.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Zero-value 4/6 lookalike of the landlord
cases.rationale: Longer suffix match; zero-value technique; past recipient target.

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Small send to a pasted 3/4 lookalike (nothing on-chain)
cases.rationale: Off-chain delivery of the lookalike (messaging app impersonation) with a small amount, below the first-send threshold.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Monthly send to her sister (contact)
cases.rationale: The everyday case: must be frictionless.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Contact address pasted in all-lowercase
cases.rationale: Same person, different valid encoding.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Rent to the landlord (past recipient, not a contact)
cases.rationale: Same address, same amount as the last three months.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Small first payment to a new friend
cases.rationale: Normal life: some friction is acceptable, a block is not.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Large first payment to a new person
cases.rationale: Legitimate, but exactly the shape of a scam; friction is defensible.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Real person whose address shares 3 leading / 4 trailing chars with Lucía
cases.rationale: A cousin who paid Daniela 40 USDC (signed by the cousin) and is being paid back. Coincidental 3/4 overlap, exactly at the CMU criterion.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: New recipient sharing 3/3 characters with Lucía
cases.rationale: Coincidental overlap one character below the CMU suffix criterion.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: New recipient sharing 4/4 characters with Lucía
cases.rationale: Rare coincidence, included to measure the cost at stricter thresholds.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: New recipient sharing 4/5 characters with Lucía
cases.rationale: Very rare coincidence at the strictest evaluated threshold.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Emergency: 400 USDC to her sister (usually 50-60)
cases.rationale: Legitimate but anomalous amount to a trusted contact.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: First send back to her son (who only sent to her before)
cases.rationale: The real son, copied correctly. Inbound history is not proof of identity.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Exchange deposit address that sent a 0.005 USDC verification deposit
cases.rationale: Tiny inbound transfers are not always attacks.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Send to her sister while unrelated airdrop dust sits in history
cases.rationale: Noise in history must not affect a trusted contact.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Sending the rest to the same friend after a successful test send
cases.rationale: The behavior the nudge asks for.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Send to her sister while history could not be loaded
cases.rationale: Outages must not block trusted contacts.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Benign 3/4 overlap with Lucía while history could not be loaded
cases.rationale: Measures the cost of the "no history means trust the match alone" rule.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: First payment exactly at the first-send threshold (25 USDC)
cases.rationale: Boundary of the light confirmation.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Rent to the landlord pasted with EIP-55 checksum casing
cases.rationale: Mixed-case, valid checksum.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Merchant invoice address sharing 3/4 characters with the landlord
cases.rationale: Coincidental overlap with a past recipient, pasted from an invoice.

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Rest sent to the friend; an unrelated inbound transfer arrived after the test
cases.rationale: Activity after a test send is not automatically an attack.
